subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: May the exact current-head revisions of the credential-bearing GitHub Actions be accepted after a supply-chain audit and redacted current-head workflow proof?
rationale: This combined Dependabot update changes code that receives repository secrets and API credentials, so the security boundary cannot be approved from package-release notes and ordinary CI status alone.

options.title: Audit and approve the full group
options.body: Inspect the exact pinned source revisions and merge only after redacted current-head evidence confirms the credentialed workflow paths work.

options.title: Split the sensitive pins
options.body: Land independently reviewed non-credentialed updates separately while retaining the GitHub App and Codex action revisions for dedicated security review.

recommendation.title: Audit and approve the full group
recommendation.body: Inspect the exact pinned source revisions and merge only after redacted current-head evidence confirms the credentialed workflow paths work.
